missions.title: Reproduce NASA's 2024 Record: How Warm Was Earth?
missions.subject: Climate Science
missions.summary: Use NASA GISTEMP v4 monthly data to reproduce the published 2024 global temperature anomaly (1.28 °C above 1951–1980) and the recent warming trend, then apply the same method to an independent dataset (HadCRUT5).
prerequisites: Spreadsheet or Python basics (helpful, not required)
missions.requirements: Any modern browser. A spreadsheet (Google Sheets, Excel, LibreOffice) or Python for the Reproduce and Prove calculations.
missions.reproduction_scope: Partial: the 2024 global annual mean anomaly and the 1975–2024 linear trend computed from the published monthly global means. The station homogenisation and spatial interpolation steps of GISTEMP are NOT reproduced.

missions.title: The Keeling Curve: Re-check a 1976 Finding
missions.subject: Climate Science
missions.summary: Keeling et al. (1976) reported that annual average CO₂ at Mauna Loa rose 3.4% between 1959 and 1971. Recompute that rise from today's NOAA record, quantify the recent growth rate, and apply the method to raw monthly data.
prerequisites: Spreadsheet or Python basics (helpful, not required)
missions.requirements: Any modern browser. A spreadsheet (Google Sheets, Excel, LibreOffice) or Python.
missions.reproduction_scope: Partial: the 1959→1971 percentage rise of the annual mean and recent growth rates, computed from NOAA's current record. The 1976 paper's own calibration and data processing are NOT reproduced, so a small, explainable difference from 3.4% is expected.
